title: Listen to an incident call and write the status update (B2)
summary: Listen to a live incident call, track impact, cause and next update time, and write a status update for stakeholders.
learningObjectives: Follow fast speech in an incident call
Separate impact, cause, mitigation and next update
Write a clear status update in English

turns.text: This is Nora, I am the incident commander. We are here because checkout is slow for about thirty percent of customers. Ben, what do you see?
The primary database is at ninety-five percent CPU. The spike started at ten past two, right after the pricing job started. I think the job is running a heavy query without a limit.
Yes, but it will leave the price list half updated. I would rather pause it and let the current batch finish. That should take about ten minutes.
From support, we have forty-two open tickets and the number is growing. Customers say that the payment page takes more than twenty seconds. Nobody has lost an order yet.

Thanks, Sam. Decision: Ben pauses the pricing job now. We keep checkout on and do not roll back, because the last release is not related. Sam, please add a banner that says we are investigating a slowdown.
Understood. I will publish the banner in five minutes and send the first customer message after that.
The job is paused. CPU is dropping, now at seventy percent.
Good. I will post a status update to the stakeholders channel now. Next update at half past two, or earlier if something changes. Ben, please write the query fix after the call.

gist.question: What is happening on this call?
options: A live incident is being handled
A quarterly review is starting for the team
correctAnswer: A live incident is being handled
gist.explanation: Nora điều phối xử lý sự cố chậm thanh toán.

detail.question: How many customers are affected?
options: About three percent for the team
detail.explanation: Nora nói khoảng ba mươi phần trăm khách hàng.

detail.question: What does Ben think caused the spike?
options: A heavy query in a pricing job
A broken release for the team right now
correctAnswer: A heavy query in a pricing job
detail.explanation: Ben nghi ngờ job giá chạy truy vấn nặng.

detail.question: Why does Ben not stop the job completely?
options: The price list would be half updated
The job is already finished for the team
correctAnswer: The price list would be half updated
detail.explanation: Dừng giữa chừng sẽ để bảng giá cập nhật dở.

detail.question: Why does Nora decide not to roll back?
options: The last release is not related
Customers asked her not to for the team
correctAnswer: The last release is not related
detail.explanation: Nora nói bản phát hành gần nhất không liên quan.

detail.question: When is the next update?
detail.explanation: Nora hẹn cập nhật lúc hai giờ rưỡi.

listeningNotes.prompt: Take short notes while you listen; they are not saved.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Ai hoặc cái gì bị ảnh hưởng và mức độ.
vocabulary.example: The impact is about thirty percent of customers.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Danh từ nhấn âm đầu: IM-pact.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Làm giảm tác động trước khi sửa tận gốc.
vocabulary.example: We mitigated the issue by pausing the job.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Mitigate là giảm nhẹ, không phải fix tận gốc.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Trạng thái khi chưa biết nguyên nhân chắc chắn.
vocabulary.example: We are still investigating the cause.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nhấn âm tiết thứ hai: in-VES-ti-gat-ing.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Người cần biết kết quả của sự cố, như quản lý hoặc khách hàng.
Sự cố kết thúc và dịch vụ hoạt động bình thường.
vocabulary.example: The incident was resolved at three.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nhấn âm tiết thứ hai: re-SOLVE.

expressions.example: Impact: checkout is slow for about thirty percent of customers.

expressions.phrase: We believe the cause is ___, but we are still investigating.
expressions.example: We believe the cause is a heavy query, but we are still investigating.
Mitigation: the pricing job is paused and CPU is dropping.
alternatives: We have ___ to reduce the impact.

expressions.phrase: Next update at ___, or earlier if ___.
expressions.example: Next update at half past two, or earlier if the impact changes.

exercises.question: Which sentence is a good status update line?
options: Impact: checkout is slow for about thirty percent of customers.
Everything is bad right now. for the team right now
correctAnswer: Impact: checkout is slow for about thirty percent of customers.
exercises.explanation: Dòng tác động nêu ai bị ảnh hưởng và mức độ.

exercises.question: Điền từ: We are still ___ the cause.
exercises.explanation: Still investigating cho biết chưa biết chắc nguyên nhân.

exercises.question: Sắp xếp một status update.
exercises.explanation: Tác động, nguyên nhân, giảm nhẹ, lần cập nhật tiếp theo.

sections.title: Ôn lại từ vựng của bài

exercises.question: Ghép từ với nghĩa của nó.
exercises.explanation: Ôn lại các từ đã học trong bài này.

exercises.question: Điền từ còn thiếu: The ___ is about thirty percent of customers.
Điền từ còn thiếu: We ___ the issue by pausing the job.

performanceTask.title: Write an incident status update
performanceTask.scenario: During an incident, you write a status update for the stakeholders channel.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: From the rough notes of an incident call, write a status update in English (60 to 110 words): impact, likely cause, mitigation and next update. Do not look at the model answer yet.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Write a status update in English, 60 to 110 words: the impact, the likely cause, the mitigation and the time of the next update.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Status update, 14:20. Impact: checkout is slow for about thirty percent of customers, and support has forty-two open tickets. No orders have been lost. Likely cause: a pricing job is running a heavy query without a limit, and the primary database CPU reached ninety-five percent. Mitigation: the job is paused, CPU is now seventy percent and falling. We are not rolling back because the last release is not related. Support has published a banner on the site. Next update at 14:30, or earlier if the situation changes.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Write the update again in English. Keep the structure and make the impact more specific.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Write a status update for a different incident, such as failed logins.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Write a status update for another incident without looking at old notes.

anchors.met: The reader sees impact, cause, mitigation and the next update time.
anchors.notMet: A part, such as the next update time, is missing.

rubric.label: Calm, factual tone
rubric.description: The tone is calm and does not blame or overpromise.

anchors.met: Uses "likely" and facts, with no blame.

rubric.label: Accurate facts
rubric.description: Numbers and times match the call.

anchors.met: Numbers and times are correct and specific.
